usedFor: Toodledo holds tasks and notes, and Kylas CRM turns them into leads or deals through “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created” in Toodledo, then “Create or Update Lead” in Kylas CRM
bestTemplate.why: Duplicate phones or emails update or skip the existing lead, so repeat tasks do not pile up copies.

watchOut: “Delete Lead” removes a lead in Kylas CRM, so keep it out of any template on “New Task Created”.
